answers.6_failure_timing: After OpenRouter received the request (HTTP 402/429 returned by the upstream provider)

audit_findings.details: The fallback telemetry and live execution logs strictly confirm that the ResilientProvider handled the invalid Gemini key cleanly, initialized the fallback chain to OpenRouter, and sent a live HTTP payload. OpenRouter successfully received and processed the request but actively rejected it due to billing account constraints (402). The failure was purely a provider/account-level rejection, meaning the architectural error-handling mechanism works exactly as designed.
